<p class="small text-muted">At the start: shuffled playlist and the saved Light Show on all configured outputs. At the stop: music stops and lights turn off. The Pis stay on for the next show. For overnight hours, days refer to the start day.</p>
<p class="small text-muted">Saved schedules run with the browser closed. Enabling during show hours starts immediately. Disabling stops a scheduled show. Manual controls remain available; the next schedule boundary takes control again.</p>
